verdict.rationale: TypeSafe's docs state that Jev is not trained on customer requests or responses, and that it is not fine-tuned or LoRA-adapted with customer data because the same weights serve every account. The docs also point to a Data Processing Agreement, a Privacy Policy and zero data retention, so customer data is excluded from training by default with no opt-out needed. Missing for 10: the DPA and Privacy Policy text themselves are not in the pack, zero data retention is limited to enterprise customers, nothing states whether Playground inputs are covered, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
